cases.customer_question: Under QPRDv3 Qualification Workspace, when adding HID11 to an existing referenced design, is testing limited to HID11-related IOPT cases or does the combined referenced profile set require broader IOPT testing?
question_variants: Does adding HID11 require all IOPT tests from the included profiles?
How does QPRDv3 change Profile Subsystem qualification testing?
Can HID11 qualification use only HID-related IOPT cases?
What IOPT scope is generated for Include QDID registrations in Qualification Workspace?
Does Option 2 profile combination trigger full interoperability testing?
cases.actual_issue: Understanding how QPRDv3 Qualification Workspace handles interoperability testing for new designs that include existing qualified designs plus added profiles.
cases.plain_english_explanation: The customer believed only the newly added HID11 profile and related interoperability tests would need testing. The consultant explained that under the newer QPRDv3 and Qualification Workspace process, adding a new profile to an included existing design causes the entire combined profile set to become part of the interoperability test scope. This is different from older PRDv2.3 Launch Studio behavior.
cases.consultant_answer: The consultant clarified that under PRDv2.3 Launch Studio, the customer's assumption would previously have been correct. However, under QPRDv3/v4 Qualification Workspace there is no registration method equivalent to adding a Profile Subsystem plus existing DN/QDID while limiting interoperability testing to only the added profile. Instead, Qualification Workspace combines the referenced profiles and newly added profile into one integrated design scope. As a result, the referenced profiles inherited from the included QDID also generate required IOPT test cases, and the added HID11 profile generates both profile tests and ICS-linked test items. The consultant listed the resulting required IOPT cases inherited from the referenced profiles.
cases.decision_logic: QPRDv3 Qualification Workspace generates testing obligations from the complete combined design represented by the included DN/QDID plus new profile additions. Interoperability requirements are based on the final integrated ICS and profile combination, not only the incremental added profile.
cases.final_recommendation: Generate the official Qualification Workspace Test Plan and execute all generated IOPT and profile test cases for the full combined design, including inherited profiles from the referenced DN/QDID and the newly added HID11 functionality.
cases.risk_if_done_wrong: Limiting testing to only HID11-related cases may leave mandatory Qualification Workspace test items incomplete, causing registration failure, rejected evidence, or rework after submission.
